Good morning Rahimudin,

Please note that extensions are calculated based on a 30-day booking cycle rather than by the calendar month or the original check-in date. Therefore, even though your initial check-in was on the 25th, the extension dates will not necessarily fall on the 25th of each month.

As per the current booking cycle, your existing extension will end on 21st August. If you wish to extend your stay further, we will be happy to assist you with the extension accordingly.

Thank you for your kind understanding.
